description: This file contains an implementation of the 'gitmemmem' function, which searches for a substring within a block of memory, similar to 'memmem'.

methods.name: void * gitmemmem(const void * haystack,size_t haystack_len,const void * needle,size_t needle_len)
methods.description: Searches for the first occurrence of a given byte sequence ('needle') within a larger block of memory ('haystack') and returns a pointer to its first occurrence or NULL if not found.
